pages.text: The five friends went to gather chestnuts in the forest. The path split in two.
Leo stepped forward. "I know everything. This way."
The other four followed him. The trees grew thicker and thicker.
Another fork appeared. Leo paused, then went right.
It grew dark between the trees. There wasn't a chestnut tree in sight.
Ahead was that same big rock again. They had gone in a circle.
Grandma Bear came from behind a tree with a chestnut sack. "Leo, have you been here before?"
Leo said softly, "No. I don't know the way." Grandma pointed to the left path.
Leo was first to stand beneath the chestnut tree. The ground was full of fallen chestnuts.
